passages.text: And again I lifted up my eyes and saw four chariots coming out from between two mountains—mountains of bronze.
passages.sermon:
Zechariah was a prophet.
He saw a vision.
He looked up.
He saw four chariots.
The chariots came out from between two mountains.
The mountains were made of bronze.
passages.original: וָאָשֻׁ֗ב וָאֶשָּׂ֤א עֵינַי֙ וָֽאֶרְאֶ֔ה וְהִנֵּ֨ה אַרְבַּ֤ע מַרְכָּבוֹת֙ יֹֽצְא֔וֹת מִבֵּ֖ין שְׁנֵ֣י הֶֽהָרִ֑ים וְהֶהָרִ֖ים הָרֵ֥י נְחֹֽשֶׁת׃

passages.text: The first chariot had red horses, the second black horses, the third white horses, and the fourth dappled horses—all of them strong.
passages.sermon:
Zechariah saw four chariots.
The first chariot had red horses.
The second chariot had black horses.
The third chariot had white horses.
The fourth chariot had dappled horses.
All the horses were strong.
passages.original: בַּמֶּרְכָּבָ֥ה הָרִֽאשֹׁנָ֖ה סוּסִ֣ים אֲדֻמִּ֑ים וּבַמֶּרְכָּבָ֥ה הַשֵּׁנִ֖ית סוּסִ֥ים שְׁחֹרִֽים׃ וּבַמֶּרְכָּבָ֥ה הַשְּׁלִשִׁ֖ית סוּסִ֣ים לְבָנִ֑ים וּבַמֶּרְכָּבָה֙ הָרְבִעִ֔ית סוּסִ֥ים בְּרֻדִּ֖ים אֲמֻצִּֽים׃

passages.text: So I inquired of the angel who was speaking with me, “What are these, my lord?”
passages.sermon:
The prophet Zechariah saw a vision.
An angel spoke with Zechariah.
Zechariah asked the angel a question.
Zechariah said, “What are these, my lord?”
passages.original: וָאַ֙עַן֙ וָֽאֹמַ֔ר אֶל־ הַמַּלְאָ֖ךְ הַדֹּבֵ֣ר בִּ֑י מָה־ אֵ֖לֶּה אֲדֹנִֽי׃

passages.text: And the angel told me, “These are the four spirits of heaven, going forth from their station before the Lord of all the earth.
passages.sermon:
The angel spoke to me.
The angel answered my question.
The angel said, “These are the four spirits of heaven.
These spirits come from their place before the Lord.
The Lord rules over all the earth.
The four spirits go out from standing before Him.”
passages.original: וַיַּ֥עַן הַמַּלְאָ֖ךְ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר אֵלָ֑י אֵ֗לֶּה אַרְבַּע֙ רֻח֣וֹת הַשָּׁמַ֔יִם יוֹצְא֕וֹת מֵֽהִתְיַצֵּ֖ב עַל־ אֲד֥וֹן כָּל־ הָאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: The one with the black horses is going toward the land of the north, the one with the white horses toward the west, and the one with the dappled horses toward the south.”
passages.sermon:
The angel spoke to me.
He explained the vision.
There are groups of horses.
The group with black horses goes to the land of the north.
The group with white horses goes after them.
The group with dappled horses goes to the land of the south.
passages.original: אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֞הּ הַסּוּסִ֣ים הַשְּׁחֹרִ֗ים יֹֽצְאִים֙ אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֔וֹן וְהַלְּבָנִ֔ים יָצְא֖וּ אֶל־ אַֽחֲרֵיהֶ֑ם וְהַ֨בְּרֻדִּ֔ים יָצְא֖וּ אֶל־ אֶ֥רֶץ הַתֵּימָֽן׃

passages.text: As the strong horses went out, they were eager to go and patrol the earth; and the LORD said, “Go and patrol the earth.” So they patrolled the earth.
passages.sermon:
The strong horses went out.
These horses wanted to go across the earth.
The LORD spoke to them.
The LORD said, "Go. Walk through the earth."
The strong horses walked through the earth.
passages.original: וְהָאֲמֻצִּ֣ים יָצְא֗וּ וַיְבַקְשׁוּ֙ לָלֶ֙כֶת֙ לְהִתְהַלֵּ֣ך בָּאָ֔רֶץ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר לְכ֖וּ הִתְהַלְּכ֣וּ בָאָ֑רֶץ וַתִּתְהַלַּ֖כְנָה בָּאָֽרֶץ׃

passages.text: Then the LORD summoned me and said, “Behold, those going to the land of the north have given rest to My Spirit in the land of the north.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD called me.
He spoke to me.
He said, “Look.
Those who go to the land of the north have brought rest to My Spirit.
They have given rest to My Spirit in the land of the north.”
passages.original: וַיַּזְעֵ֣ק אֹתִ֔י וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר אֵלַ֖י לֵאמֹ֑ר רְאֵ֗ה הַיּֽוֹצְאִים֙ אֶל־ אֶ֣רֶץ צָפ֔וֹן הֵנִ֥יחוּ אֶת־ רוּחִ֖י בְּאֶ֥רֶץ צָפֽוֹן׃ס

passages.text: The word of the LORD also came to me, saying, “Take an offering from the exiles—from Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah, who have arrived from Babylon—and go that same day to the house of Josiah son of Zephaniah.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to me.
He gave me a message.
He told me to take an offering from the exiles.
The exiles are Heldai, Tobijah, and Jedaiah.
They have come from Babylon.
He told me to go that same day.
He told me to go to the house of Josiah.
Josiah is the son of Zephaniah.
passages.original: וַיְהִ֥י דְבַר־ יְהוָ֖ה אֵלַ֥י לֵאמֹֽר׃ לָק֙וֹחַ֙ מֵאֵ֣ת הַגּוֹלָ֔ה מֵחֶלְדַּ֕י וּמֵאֵ֥ת טוֹבִיָּ֖ה וּמֵאֵ֣ת יְדַֽעְיָ֑ה וּבָאתָ֤ אַתָּה֙ בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֔וּא וּבָ֗אתָ בֵּ֚ית יֹאשִׁיָּ֣ה בֶן־ צְפַנְיָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־ בָּ֖אוּ מִבָּבֶֽל׃

passages.text: Take silver and gold, make an ornate crown, and set it on the head of the high priest, Joshua son of Jehozadak.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Zechariah.
God gave Zechariah a command.
Zechariah must take silver and gold.
Zechariah must make a crown from the silver and gold.
Joshua is the son of Jehozadak.
Joshua is the high priest.
Zechariah must place the crown on Joshua’s head.
passages.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֥ כֶֽסֶף־ וְזָהָ֖ב וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ עֲטָר֑וֹת וְשַׂמְתָּ֗ בְּרֹ֛אשׁ יְהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בֶּן־ יְהוֹצָדָ֖ק הַכֹּהֵ֥ן הַגָּדֽוֹל׃

passages.text: And you are to tell him that this is what the LORD of Hosts says: ‘Here is a man whose name is the Branch, and He will branch out from His place and build the temple of the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD of Hosts spoke to me.
He gave me a message for Joshua the high priest.
The LORD of Hosts says this.
There is a man called the Branch.
He will grow up from his own place.
He will build the temple of the LORD.
passages.original: וְאָמַרְתָּ֤ אֵלָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר כֹּ֥ה אָמַ֛ר יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת לֵאמֹ֑ר הִנֵּה־ אִ֞ישׁ צֶ֤מַח שְׁמוֹ֙ וּמִתַּחְתָּ֣יו יִצְמָ֔ח וּבָנָ֖ה אֶת־ הֵיכַ֥ל יְהוָֽהּ׃

passages.text: Yes, He will build the temple of the LORD; He will be clothed in splendor and will sit on His throne and rule. And He will be a priest on His throne, and there will be peaceful counsel between the two.’
passages.sermon:
The man called the Branch will build the temple of the LORD.
He will carry great honor.
He will sit on his throne.
He will rule from his throne.
He will also serve as a priest on his throne.
There will be peaceful counsel between the king and the priest.
passages.original: וְ֠הוּא יִבְנֶ֞ה אֶת־ הֵיכַ֤ל יְהוָה֙ וְהֽוּא־ יִשָּׂ֣א ה֔וֹד וְיָשַׁ֥ב וּמָשַׁ֖ל עַל־ כִּסְא֑וֹ וְהָיָ֤ה כֹהֵן֙ עַל־ כִּסְא֔וֹ וַעֲצַ֣ת שָׁל֔וֹם תִּהְיֶ֖ה בֵּ֥ין שְׁנֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: The crown will reside in the temple of the LORD as a memorial to Helem, Tobijah, Jedaiah, and the gracious son of Zephaniah.
passages.sermon:
The crown will stay in the temple of the LORD.
The crown will serve as a memorial.
The crown will honor Helem.
The crown will honor Tobijah.
The crown will honor Jedaiah.
The crown will honor Hen, the son of Zephaniah.
passages.original: וְהָעֲטָרֹ֗ת תִּֽהְיֶה֙ לְחֵ֙לֶם֙ וּלְטוֹבִיָּ֣ה וְלִידַֽעְיָ֔ה וּלְחֵ֖ן בֶּן־ צְפַנְיָ֑ה לְזִכָּר֖וֹן בְּהֵיכַ֥ל יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Even those far away will come and build the temple of the LORD, and you will know that the LORD of Hosts has sent Me to you. This will happen if you diligently obey the voice of the LORD your God.”
passages.sermon:
People who live far away will come.
They will build the temple of the LORD.
You will know that the LORD of Hosts has sent Me to you.
This will happen if you obey the voice of the LORD your God.
passages.original: וּרְחוֹקִ֣ים׀ יָבֹ֗אוּ וּבָנוּ֙ בְּהֵיכַ֣ל יְהוָ֔ה וִידַעְתֶּ֕ם כִּֽי־ יְהוָ֥ה צְבָא֖וֹת שְׁלָחַ֣נִי אֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וְהָיָה֙ אִם־ שָׁמ֣וֹעַ תִּשְׁמְע֔וּן בְּק֖וֹל יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃ס
